title: Automatic actions I. Bounded automata and orbits
summary: We develop the theory of "automatic actions": (semi)groups acting by $ω$-regular transformations on an $ω$-regular language, showing that it covers a large class of heretofore-unrelated examples. We focus on the subclass of actions by "bounded" $ω$-regular transformations, those for which the Büchi automata encoding the action do not have two connected non-trivial cycles. We show that, for bounded actions of inverse semigroups, the orbit relation is also $ω$-regular. We deduce a number of corollaries, in particular decidability, for such actions, of minimality, topological transitivity,…
